  390 +    const db = new Database(dbPath);
  391 +    db.exec(`CREATE TABLE conversations_v2 (
  392 +      key TEXT NOT NULL, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL,
  393 +      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  394 +      PRIMARY KEY (key, conversation_id))`);
  395 +    const seed = [{ user: { content: {} }, assistant: { Response: { message_id: "k0", content: "seed-text ".repeat(12) } } }];
  396 +    const updatedAt = Date.now() - 10_000;
  397 +    db.prepare("INSERT INTO conversations_v2 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
  398 +      .run(WORK_DIR, "conversation-live", JSON.stringify({ history: seed }), Date.now() - 60_000, updatedAt);
  399 +    const sessionsDir = join(root, "no-jsonl-here");

  401 +    expect((await source.poll()).assistantTexts).toHaveLength(0);
